achievements.title: First flight
achievements.preEarned: Fly your airline's first passenger service.
achievements.earned: Your first flight left the gate — and brought in your first ticket money.

achievements.title: First aircraft of your own
achievements.preEarned: Buy an aircraft outright instead of leasing it.
achievements.earned: You own an aircraft outright. No lease, no landlord.

achievements.title: First profitable month
achievements.preEarned: Close a month with your airline in profit.
achievements.earned: A whole month in the black. The airline pays its own way.

achievements.title: Regional carrier
achievements.preEarned: Grow your startup into a regional airline.
achievements.earned: You run a regional airline, with a network people rely on.

achievements.title: Ten destinations
achievements.earned: Ten airports on your route map.

achievements.title: 100,000 passengers
achievements.earned: One hundred thousand people have flown with you.

achievements.title: First million-dollar month
achievements.preEarned: Earn a million dollars of profit in a single month.
achievements.earned: A million-dollar month. The airline is a real business now.

achievements.title: National airline
achievements.earned: A national airline, with the reputation to match.

achievements.title: First intercontinental route
achievements.preEarned: Open a route between two continents.
achievements.earned: Your first route across an ocean.

achievements.title: One million passengers
achievements.earned: A million passengers have trusted you to get them there.

achievements.title: Airline empire
achievements.earned: From one aircraft on one route to an airline empire.

achievements.title: Debt free
achievements.preEarned: Run a substantial airline with no debt at all.
achievements.earned: A real airline, and not a cent owed to anyone.

achievements.title: Weatherproof
achievements.preEarned: Keep flight completion above 97% across hundreds of flights.
achievements.earned: Storms, fog and snow — and your flights still went.

achievements.title: Value legend
achievements.preEarned: Hold an outstanding value reputation for a full season.
achievements.earned: Passengers know your fares are worth it.

achievements.title: Single-family purist
achievements.preEarned: Build your whole fleet from one manufacturer.
achievements.earned: One manufacturer, one fleet, perfect commonality.
